news.title: Trump’s Arch Faces New Legal Challenge From Virginia and D.C.
news.summary: The two jurisdictions contend that President Trump’s proposed 250-foot arch is “flagrantly unlawful,” citing concerns over traffic, the environment and historic preservation.
